text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I logged into the battle royale game I had played previously, I was placed on the same team as Tokai Teio once again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Yay, I'm on the same team as Teio! 
I'm gonna do way better than Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll leave the front lines to you! 
I'm in charge of strategy and commands this time~."
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to fight on the front lines?
Aren't you going to fight on the front lines?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Ehehe. Charging out to the front isn't the only way to be cool!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Calling the shots from the shadows in style and toy around with the enemy! 
Today's Lady Teio is something else!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio then demonstrated command by making full use of the game's systems, utilizing close chat communications, tactical planning, and traps.

text_block_list.name: Teammate Chat
text_block_list.text:
—"We did it! Baited them just as instructed! 
The trap worked like a charm!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Brilliant! Next, move over to Point B! 
I pinned it on the map, so go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Teio! Let's go defeat enemies~! 
You haven't fought at all this whole time!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"No~pe. Master Strategist Lady Teio is busy right now. 
I'm gracefully directing everyone from behind the scenes. 
If you want to fight, go ahead on your own!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Turbo wants to play together with Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Then wanna make traps together? 
We're short on materials to place pitfall traps, so first let's gather 'Lumber'—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"No no no!! Boring! 
This isn't like Teio at all!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Fine then! 
Turbo's gonna go rampage all alone!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, she ran off. Sheesh... 
What does she mean, 'not like me'..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Well anyway. I have to keep the strategy going. 
Trap craft, trap craft, and—"
choice_data_list: Should I go back Turbo up?
Should I go back Turbo up?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...Hmm. For now, let's check what Turbo's doing on the team cam."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa!? Enemies everywhere! 
Hehehe, I won't lose~!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, she's surrounded already!? 
Ah, don't just charge in! 
Hide behind the slope, or zigzag around!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "That's what I'd do...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"No no no!! Boring! 
This isn't like Teio at all!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Not like me, huh. 
Just giving orders from out of sight like this."
choice_data_list: Do you want to fight yourself after all?
Do you want to fight yourself after all?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. But I don't want to abandon commanding everyone either. 
So—I'll just do both!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to do all that is what makes me, me! 
A true 'Emperor'!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Uwaaah! My HP's almost gone~! 
Ngggh... Not yet! I'm not giving up!"

text_block_list.name: Enemy Player
text_block_list.text:
"All right! This is the en— 
Wait, whoa!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"—I came to rampage, Turbo! 
Just like you wanted!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Te... Teio!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go, Turbo! 
Together, we'll drive the enemies into the woods over there!"

text_block_list.name: Enemy Player
text_block_list.text:
"Damn it, what is this!? 
The moment she showed up, everyone got wiped out! 
We have to fall back for now—"

text_block_list.name: Enemy Player
text_block_list.text: "—Aaaargh!? A pitfall trap!?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Nice! Good job, Turbo! 
Thanks to us attacking from two directions, we herded them in perfectly!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, strategy huge success! 
You can be a great commander and a warrior... 
That's the Teio Turbo acknowledged!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally! I'm the genius Lady Teio! 
Now then, let's wrap this match up!"

text_block_list.name: Teio's Chat
text_block_list.text:
—"Everyone, we're in the endgame! 
Drive the enemy towards the trap coordinates marked on the map all at once!"

text_block_list.name: Teio's Chat
text_block_list.text:
—"Victory is already guaranteed. 
Because the one leading the charge at your front... is the 'Invincible Emperor'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... rallied around Tokai Teio, who backed up her words with godly plays, the team united and claimed a magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu... It doesn't matter what situation comes up! 
Versatility is the true mark of an 'Emperor'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Performing all across the board as both warrior and commander... Tokai Teio showed a playstyle truly worthy of the title "Emperor"!
